review_evidence: README describes TypeTopology as a long-running blackboard for new constructive univalent mathematics intended for publication.
The source tree contains 995 primary Agda/literate-Agda files, with dedicated indices and module descriptions for definitions, concepts, and theorems.
No source-local subtree was identified as losslessly removable maintenance material; the mathematical development is the repository purpose.
summary: Retain TypeTopology: a large Agda development of constructive univalent mathematics with nearly one thousand primary literate source files.

Read source/InfinitePigeon/Cantor.lagda completely: module InfinitePigeon.Cantor defines the Cantor type ₂ℕ = ℕ → ₂.
Read source/InfinitePigeon/Two.lagda completely: data ₂ with constructors ₀ and ₁, the function not, and the lemma two-equality-cases.

summary: Retain all 69 changed literate Agda files. I surveyed the file list by top-level directory (19 C-Spaces, 10 InfinitePigeon, 9 UF, 5 TypeTopology, 5 Locales, 4 EffectfulForcing, and single files in 14 other directories) and ran a per-file count of \begin{code} blocks and Agda declaration lines. Every file has at least one code block and at least 6 declaration lines. The smallest files (InfinitePigeon/Cantor, InfinitePigeon/Two, UF/PropTrunc-Variation) hold real definitions and proofs. The three index files (source/index.lagda, Ordinals/index.lagda, TypeTopology/index.lagda) have an OPTIONS pragma, a module declaration, imports, and prose; under FILTER-007 they are navigation modules that are ranked, not excluded. The large files hold theorems about locales, compact types, and univalent foundations. No file meets the FILTER-004 exclusion bar.
